_about: Walsh Library as one drawn building (decisions/0020), in the shared house style with its entrance facing south (decisions/0021). Footprint rows use the map legend (game/world/tiles.py). The two 'A' cells in the bottom row are the main entrance. 'nameplate' is where the name plaque goes, in pixels from the footprint's top-left (centre x, top y). The tiles only show if map.png is missing; the minimap reads them for colors.
name: William D. Walsh Family Library
